steps.title: Analyze Layout and Structure
steps.description: Inspect activity_main.xml and assign an ID to the FrameLayout container to host dynamically spawned floating feedback elements.

steps.title: Define State Trackers for Animation Transitions
steps.description: Establish class variables in MainActivity.java to cache current and previous background/card colors for smooth transition rendering.

steps.title: Implement Springy Counter Pop Animation
steps.description: Add a fast-acting multi-stage scale-up and scale-down springy animation on the counter text display when users trigger a tap.

steps.title: Create Realtime Dynamic Floating Indicator Particles
steps.description: Build programmatic text floating bubbles spawning on tap that drift upwards, translate horizontally with random drift, and fade out cleanly.

steps.title: Incorporate ValueAnimator for Background Transitions
steps.description: Create an ArgbEvaluator with ValueAnimator to transition root background layout colors smoothly over 450ms during theme swaps.

steps.title: Animate Dashboard Metric Card Morphing
steps.description: Blend metric container styles dynamically via sequential color interpolations during theme cycles to minimize visual harshness.

steps.title: Add High Score Scale Pulsating Feedback
steps.description: Apply a distinctive scaling pop-and-recovery animation to the floating best badge widget whenever a milestone is achieved.

steps.title: Integrate Activity Log Entry Slide Animations
steps.description: Set entry logs layout opacity to zero and translate offset down, followed by a 300ms glide-up to build timeline transitions dynamically.

steps.title: Verify UI Responsiveness and Build Parameters
steps.description: Inspect all custom animations for compliance with SDK 21 and Java 8 rules, avoiding lambdas in animation updates.

steps.title: Building Simple Tap Counter
steps.description: Perform validation and compilation checks on modified files to generate final debug packaging successfully.
